verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a Forge/Playground trial UI for uploading documents, but there is no evidence of an interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/Redoc-style console) with runnable per-endpoint examples; a direct probe for OpenAPI/Swagger specs returned 404 on all candidate paths, indicating no such interactive reference is exposed. missing for 10: an actual interactive API reference page, runnable code/try-it panels per endpoint, discoverable OpenAPI spec.
